# Plate: X -20 to 20 (40), Y -10 to 10 (20), Z 0 to 3 (3)
plate = cq.Workplane("XY").box(40, 20, 3, centered=(True, True, False))

import cadquery as cq

# Plate X 0..40, Y 0..20, Z 0..4
plate = cq.Workplane("XY").box(40, 20, 4, centered=(False, False, False))

# Round boss: diameter 10 at (10,10), Z 4..14
boss = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=4)
    .moveTo(10, 10)
    .circle(5)
    .extrude(10)
)

base = plate.union(boss)

# 3 mm hole along Z through boss and plate at (10,10)
hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=0)
    .moveTo(10, 10)
    .circle(1.5)
    .extrude(14)
)

# Slot: obround 16 long (Y) x 6 wide (X) centred at (28,10), through plate Z 0..4
# rectangle 6 x 10 centred at (28,10) plus two end caps radius 3
slot_rect = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=0)
    .moveTo(28, 10)
    .rect(6, 10)
    .extrude(4)
)
slot_cyl1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=0)
    .moveTo(28, 2)
    .circle(3)
    .extrude(4)
)
slot_cyl2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=0)
    .moveTo(28, 18)
    .circle(3)
    .extrude(4)
)
slot = slot_rect.union(slot_cyl1).union(slot_cyl2)

result = base.cut(hole).cut(slot)
